name: – Siegfried Mureşan, Carla Tavares – After § 26 – Am 67
title: INTERIM REPORT on the proposal for a Council regulation laying down the Multiannual Financial Framework for the years 2028 to 2034
part_text: 26e. Expresses its deep concern over the Commission’s plan to make agricultural support conditional on compliance with the Rule of Law Conditionality Regulation; recalls that previous approaches have revealed a lack of objectivity on the part of the Commission towards certain Member States; warns that such decisions may have a direct and negative impact on farmers’ incomes in the Member States in question;
